output.explanation: Implemented all ten B11 updates from the pinned sources. Frozen comparison sessions now have their own lifecycle, while reusable contexts preserve original descriptors and hashes and resolve pinned evidence for consumers. Managed generation distinguishes fresh threads using saved context from parent-thread forks. Existing attachment labels and reserved bounds are preserved. These changes establish durable comparison endpoints and reusable evidence for subsequent reads and generation.
